title: Oracle to deploy 50,000 AMD MI450 GPUs from 2026

sources.quote: Building on years of co-innovation, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) will be a launch partner for the first publicly available AI supercluster powered by AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs—with an initial deployment of 50,000 GPUs starting in calendar Q3 2026 and expanding in 2027 and beyond.

explain: Oracle's cloud will buy and install 50,000 of AMD's next-generation MI450 AI chips starting in the third quarter of 2026, to rent out to customers. The price was not disclosed.
